spec.rawSql:
WITH devices(device_id,device_name) AS (VALUES ('meter-main','主电表'),('meter-secondary','分电表'),('socket-example','插座'))
SELECT d.device_name AS "设备",CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc IS NULL THEN '尚无数据' WHEN s.sample_time_utc<now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN '数据过期' ELSE '正常' END AS "状态",
s.sample_time_utc AS "最后采集时间",round(extract(epoch FROM(now()-s.sample_time_utc))) AS "距今秒数",s.energy_kwh AS "累计表底（度）"
FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sample_time_utc,energy_kwh FROM iot.home_electricity_samples WHERE device_id=d.device_id AND sample_time_utc<=now() ORDER BY sample_time_utc DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true

options.content:
安装基准由部署者在私有配置中登记。安装至首条采样之间不补造每日用电。

已计用电只累加不超过 15 分钟的有效相邻增量；首末读数差可跨越缺口，两者口径不同。缺失日期不补零。

spec.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AS start_time_utc, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz,now()) AS end_time_utc),
deduplicated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,record_time_utc) device_id,device_name,record_time_utc,energy_kwh
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples,bounds
 WHERE record_time_utc >= start_time_utc-interval '15 minutes'
   AND record_time_utc <= end_time_utc AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_installation
 ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id
), steps AS (
 SELECT *,lag(record_time_utc) OVER w AS previous_time_utc,
 energy_kwh-lag(energy_kwh) OVER w AS delta_kwh
 FROM deduplicated WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY record_time_utc)
), valid AS (
 SELECT * FROM steps WHERE delta_kwh>=0 AND record_time_utc>previous_time_utc
 AND record_time_utc-previous_time_utc<=interval '15 minutes'
) SELECT sum(delta_kwh*(extract(epoch FROM (least(record_time_utc,end_time_utc)-greatest(previous_time_utc,start_time_utc)))/extract(epoch FROM (record_time_utc-previous_time_utc)))) AS energy_kwh FROM valid,bounds WHERE device_id='meter-main' AND record_time_utc>start_time_utc AND previous_time_utc<end_time_utc

spec.description: 仅累计连续有效区间；缺口不计入，请结合旁边覆盖率。随右上角时间范围变化。
spec.title: 主电表 · 所选时段 · 已计用电

deduplicated AS (

spec.rawSql:
WITH ranked AS (
 SELECT record_time_utc,device_name,energy_kwh,is_installation,
 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY device_id,floor(extract(epoch FROM record_time_utc)/$__interval_ms*1000) ORDER BY record_time_utc DESC,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id) rn
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples WHERE device_id IN ('meter-main','socket-example') AND $__timeFilter(record_time_utc) AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT record_time_utc AS time,device_name AS metric,energy_kwh AS value FROM ranked WHERE rn=1 ORDER BY 1,2

spec.title: 主电表 / 插座 · 累计表底双轴

spec.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',$__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS start_time_utc, least($__timeTo()::timestamptz,now()) AS end_time_utc),
deduplicated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,record_time_utc) device_id,device_name,record_time_utc,energy_kwh
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples,bounds
 WHERE record_time_utc >= start_time_utc-interval '15 minutes'
   AND record_time_utc <= end_time_utc AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_installation
 ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id
), steps AS (
 SELECT *,lag(record_time_utc) OVER w AS previous_time_utc,
 energy_kwh-lag(energy_kwh) OVER w AS delta_kwh
 FROM deduplicated WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY record_time_utc)
), valid AS (
 SELECT * FROM steps WHERE delta_kwh>=0 AND record_time_utc>previous_time_utc
 AND record_time_utc-previous_time_utc<=interval '15 minutes'
), days AS (
 SELECT day_local AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS day_time_utc,
        (day_local+interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS next_day_time_utc
 FROM bounds CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(start_time_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai',end_time_utc AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai',interval '1 day') day_local
), segments AS (
 SELECT v.device_id,day_local AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS day_time_utc,v.delta_kwh,
 extract(epoch FROM(v.record_time_utc-v.previous_time_utc)) AS interval_seconds,
 extract(epoch FROM(least(v.record_time_utc,(day_local+interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai',end_time_utc)-greatest(v.previous_time_utc,day_local AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai',start_time_utc))) AS covered_seconds
 FROM valid v CROSS JOIN bounds CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
 date_trunc('day',greatest(v.previous_time_utc,start_time_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'),
 date_trunc('day',least(v.record_time_utc,end_time_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'),interval '1 day') day_local
 WHERE v.record_time_utc>start_time_utc AND v.previous_time_utc<end_time_utc
), daily_totals AS (
 SELECT device_id,day_time_utc,sum(delta_kwh*covered_seconds/interval_seconds) AS energy_kwh,
 sum(covered_seconds) AS covered_seconds FROM segments WHERE covered_seconds>0 GROUP BY 1,2
), devices(device_id,device_name) AS (VALUES ('meter-main','主电表'),('meter-secondary','分电表'),('socket-example','插座'))
SELECT days.day_time_utc AS time,d.device_name AS metric,100*coalesce(v.covered_seconds,0)/nullif(extract(epoch FROM(least(next_day_time_utc,now())-days.day_time_utc)),0) AS value
FROM days CROSS JOIN devices d LEFT JOIN daily_totals v ON v.device_id=d.device_id AND v.day_time_utc=days.day_time_utc
ORDER BY 1,2

spec.description: 低覆盖率的日期只显示已计部分；没有采样的日期为 0% 覆盖率，不代表 0 度用电。
spec.title: 每日采样覆盖率

spec.rawSql:
WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM iot.home_electricity_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(record_time_utc) AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL),
firsts AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(device_id) * FROM r ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id),
lasts AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON(device_id) * FROM r ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc DESC,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id)
SELECT a.device_name AS "设备",a.record_time_utc AS "首条时间",a.energy_kwh AS "期初表底（度）",b.record_time_utc AS "末条时间",b.energy_kwh AS "期末表底（度）",
 CASE WHEN b.record_time_utc>a.record_time_utc THEN b.energy_kwh-a.energy_kwh END AS "首末读数差（度）",
 a.time_basis AS "首条时间依据",b.time_basis AS "末条时间依据"
FROM firsts a JOIN lasts b USING(device_id) ORDER BY a.device_id

spec.description: 首末读数差可跨采样缺口，只是两次读数的差值；不代表完整覆盖所选时段，也不分配到缺失日期。计数器重置或更换需另行核实。
spec.title: 所选时段 · 首末表底对照

spec.rawSql:
WITH states AS (WITH devices(device_id,device_name) AS (VALUES ('meter-main','主电表'),('meter-secondary','分电表'),('socket-example','插座'))
SELECT d.device_name AS "设备",CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc IS NULL THEN '尚无数据' WHEN s.sample_time_utc<now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN '数据过期' ELSE '正常' END AS "状态",
s.sample_time_utc AS "最后采集时间",round(extract(epoch FROM(now()-s.sample_time_utc))) AS "距今秒数",s.energy_kwh AS "累计表底（度）"
FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sample_time_utc,energy_kwh FROM iot.home_electricity_samples WHERE device_id=d.device_id AND sample_time_utc<=now() ORDER BY sample_time_utc DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true), coverage AS (SELECT '主电表' AS device_name,coverage_pct FROM (WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS start_time_utc, now() AS end_time_utc),
deduplicated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,record_time_utc) device_id,device_name,record_time_utc,energy_kwh
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples,bounds
 WHERE record_time_utc >= start_time_utc-interval '15 minutes'
   AND record_time_utc <= end_time_utc AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_installation
 ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id
), steps AS (
 SELECT *,lag(record_time_utc) OVER w AS previous_time_utc,
 energy_kwh-lag(energy_kwh) OVER w AS delta_kwh
 FROM deduplicated WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY record_time_utc)
), valid AS (
 SELECT * FROM steps WHERE delta_kwh>=0 AND record_time_utc>previous_time_utc
 AND record_time_utc-previous_time_utc<=interval '15 minutes'
) SELECT 100*coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM (least(record_time_utc,end_time_utc)-greatest(previous_time_utc,start_time_utc)))),0)/nullif(extract(epoch FROM (now()-(date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))),0) AS coverage_pct FROM valid,bounds WHERE device_id='meter-main' AND record_time_utc>start_time_utc AND previous_time_utc<end_time_utc) q UNION ALL SELECT '分电表' AS device_name,coverage_pct FROM (WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS start_time_utc, now() AS end_time_utc),
deduplicated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,record_time_utc) device_id,device_name,record_time_utc,energy_kwh
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples,bounds
 WHERE record_time_utc >= start_time_utc-interval '15 minutes'
   AND record_time_utc <= end_time_utc AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_installation
 ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id
), steps AS (
 SELECT *,lag(record_time_utc) OVER w AS previous_time_utc,
 energy_kwh-lag(energy_kwh) OVER w AS delta_kwh
 FROM deduplicated WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY record_time_utc)
), valid AS (
 SELECT * FROM steps WHERE delta_kwh>=0 AND record_time_utc>previous_time_utc
 AND record_time_utc-previous_time_utc<=interval '15 minutes'
) SELECT 100*coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM (least(record_time_utc,end_time_utc)-greatest(previous_time_utc,start_time_utc)))),0)/nullif(extract(epoch FROM (now()-(date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))),0) AS coverage_pct FROM valid,bounds WHERE device_id='meter-secondary' AND record_time_utc>start_time_utc AND previous_time_utc<end_time_utc) q UNION ALL SELECT '插座' AS device_name,coverage_pct FROM (WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS start_time_utc, now() AS end_time_utc),
deduplicated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,record_time_utc) device_id,device_name,record_time_utc,energy_kwh
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples,bounds
 WHERE record_time_utc >= start_time_utc-interval '15 minutes'
   AND record_time_utc <= end_time_utc AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_installation
 ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id
), steps AS (
 SELECT *,lag(record_time_utc) OVER w AS previous_time_utc,
 energy_kwh-lag(energy_kwh) OVER w AS delta_kwh
 FROM deduplicated WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY record_time_utc)
), valid AS (
 SELECT * FROM steps WHERE delta_kwh>=0 AND record_time_utc>previous_time_utc
 AND record_time_utc-previous_time_utc<=interval '15 minutes'
) SELECT 100*coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM (least(record_time_utc,end_time_utc)-greatest(previous_time_utc,start_time_utc)))),0)/nullif(extract(epoch FROM (now()-(date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'))),0) AS coverage_pct FROM valid,bounds WHERE device_id='socket-example' AND record_time_utc>start_time_utc AND previous_time_utc<end_time_utc) q)
SELECT string_agg(s."设备"||'：'||CASE WHEN s."状态"<>'正常' THEN s."状态"
 WHEN c.coverage_pct<98 THEN '今日数据不完整，请查看用电明细页'
 ELSE '采集正常' END,'　｜　' ORDER BY s."设备") AS "提示"
FROM states s JOIN coverage c ON c.device_name=s."设备"

 SELECT v.device_id,day_local AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS day_time_utc,v.delta_kwh,
 extract(epoch FROM(v.record_time_utc-v.previous_time_utc)) AS interval_seconds,
 extract(epoch FROM(least(v.record_time_utc,(day_local+interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai',end_time_utc)-greatest(v.previous_time_utc,day_local AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai',start_time_utc))) AS covered_seconds
 FROM valid v CROSS JOIN bounds CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
 date_trunc('day',greatest(v.previous_time_utc,start_time_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'),
 date_trunc('day',least(v.record_time_utc,end_time_utc) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai'),interval '1 day') day_local
 WHERE v.record_time_utc>start_time_utc AND v.previous_time_utc<end_time_utc
), daily_totals AS (
 SELECT device_id,day_time_utc,sum(delta_kwh*covered_seconds/interval_seconds) AS energy_kwh,
 sum(covered_seconds) AS covered_seconds FROM segments WHERE covered_seconds>0 GROUP BY 1,2
), devices(device_id,device_name) AS (VALUES ('meter-main','主电表'),('meter-secondary','分电表'),('socket-example','插座'))
SELECT days.day_time_utc AS time,d.device_name AS metric,v.energy_kwh AS value
FROM days CROSS JOIN devices d LEFT JOIN daily_totals v ON v.device_id=d.device_id AND v.day_time_utc=days.day_time_utc
ORDER BY 1,2

spec.rawSql:
WITH bounds AS (SELECT date_trunc('day',now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai' AS start_time_utc, now() AS end_time_utc),
deduplicated AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT ON (device_id,record_time_utc) device_id,device_name,record_time_utc,energy_kwh
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples,bounds
 WHERE record_time_utc >= start_time_utc-interval '15 minutes'
   AND record_time_utc <= end_time_utc AND energy_kwh IS NOT NULL AND NOT is_installation
 ORDER BY device_id,record_time_utc,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id
), steps AS (
 SELECT *,lag(record_time_utc) OVER w AS previous_time_utc,
 energy_kwh-lag(energy_kwh) OVER w AS delta_kwh
 FROM deduplicated WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY record_time_utc)

WITH devices(device_id,device_name) AS (VALUES ('meter-main','主电表'),('meter-secondary','分电表'),('socket-example','插座'))
SELECT d.device_name AS "设备",s.sample_time_utc AS "采样时间",
CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc>=now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN s.voltage_v END AS "电压（V）",
CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc>=now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN s.current_a END AS "电流（A）",
CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc>=now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN s.reactive_power_var END AS "无功功率（var）",
CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc>=now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN s.power_factor END AS "功率因数",
CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc>=now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN s.frequency_hz END AS "频率（Hz）",
CASE WHEN s.sample_time_utc>=now()-interval '5 minutes' THEN s.voltage_v*s.current_a END AS "视在功率（VA，计算）"
FROM devices d LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT sample_time_utc,voltage_v,current_a,reactive_power_var,power_factor,frequency_hz
 FROM iot.home_electricity_samples WHERE device_id=d.device_id AND quality='ok'
 AND sample_time_utc<=now() ORDER BY sample_time_utc DESC,receive_time_utc DESC,message_id LIMIT 1
) s ON true

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(read_time_utc,$__interval,NULL),device_name || ' · ' || sensor_name AS metric,avg(temperature_c) AS value FROM iot.home_server_temperature_samples WHERE $__timeFilter(read_time_utc) AND (${temperature_category:sqlstring} = '全部' OR
  CASE
    WHEN sensor_id IN ('cpu_temperature_c','gpu_temperature_c','cpu_package_temperature_c')
      OR sensor_id ~ '^cpu_core_[0-9]{1,2}_temperature_c$' THEN 'CPU/GPU'
    WHEN sensor_id ~ '^mainboard_channel_[1-9]_temperature_c$' THEN '主板'
    WHEN sensor_id = 'ddr_temperature_c' THEN '内存'
    WHEN sensor_id ~ '^nvme_[a-z0-9]+(_sensor_[0-9]+)?_temperature_c
    ELSE '其他'
  END = ${temperature_category:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
      OR sensor_id IN ('sata_ssd_a_temperature_c','sata_ssd_b_temperature_c','sata_hdd_a_temperature_c') THEN '硬盘'
    ELSE '其他'
  END = ${temperature_category:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
